{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g is missing
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute the Pearson correlation and print it directly
result = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])
print(result)

# Also print the rounded value to 3 decimal places, as it will be used in the answer
print(round(result, 3))"}
